title: Desktop volume controls and local MGM Bedrock retirement

statements.text: Keep a speaker icon visible; click opens a volume slider, percentage and mute control; leaving the popup closes it.
Control the current macOS audio output without extra software; report unsupported volume control rather than pretending success.
Keep Apple menu-bar auto-hide enabled on desktop and fullscreen; diagnose intermittent failure and remove verified local interference without claiming to fix unreproduced OS bugs.
The personal dotfiles repository owns managed desktop and local AWS retirement changes; preserve unrelated primary-checkout work.
Remove the AWS SketchyBar item and disable scheduled, reactive and manual MGM Bedrock auth automation, including future startup paths.
Preserve existing CLI authentication source inactive outside deployment for later Vertex reuse; do not implement Vertex now.
Remove only attributable local MGM Bedrock profiles, sessions and cached credentials. Broad AWS deletion is superseded; do not delete cloud resources.
Preserve Backblaze B2 credentials and profile, shared AWS CLI, and unrelated AWS configuration and caches.
Native auto-hide failed initial host validation and later passed operator checks; the exact recovery cause is not isolated and future OS reliability is not guaranteed.
Retain the existing hover helper with below-native SketchyBar layering; SketchyBar starts it only when missing. Retiring the helper failed operator expectations.
The operator selected lighter local completion, focused validation and a local commit without a push. Preserve the incomplete DBSCTR cycle and its failed evidence rather than claiming it passed.
